veranderings.na: Dan vorm die juwelier die metaal
veranderings.rede: The pronoun 'sy' sits two sentences away from 'n Juwelier', after sentences about the gold and the rings, so naming the jeweller again makes the reference clear.

veranderings.blok: Wat die goud se pad kos
veranderings.na: Om diep te grawe en lang tonnels te maak.
veranderings.rede: 'Diep grawe' can be read as an adjective plus the plural of 'graaf' (deep spades); a verb construction makes the activity unambiguous.
